responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s source-file search-path service. It exposes initialization and extension of the module search path, generic file lookup, specialized definition and implementation/program module lookup by stem name, and configurable default extensions, isolating source discovery policy from the compilation driver.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the mcSearch stem, declaring search-path setup, lookup, and extension-selection routines; unlike mcSearch.mod, it does not store paths, construct candidate filenames, or probe the filesystem.
